question: A warehouse had 224 pallets of canned vegetables at the start of the day. A retailer order removed 156 pallets that morning, and a supplier delivered 18 more pallets that afternoon. A quality check then pulled 37 pallets for inspection, while a second supplier added 77 more. A citywide distributor then left the warehouse with 3 times as many pallets. Finally, 15 more pallets arrived from a delayed truck, around the time gas prices hit 4 dollars a gallon, unrelated to the pallet count. How many pallets did the warehouse have in the end?

A courier firm bills its clients by the minute. In the morning Dana drove 8 routes of 89 minutes each, and then the dispatcher struck 74 minutes of idling from the log. In the afternoon the second driver logged exactly as many minutes as the whole morning total, so the running total doubled. Before dinner the client disputed 906 minutes, which were removed from the bill. In the evening Dana drove for one more hour, which is 60 minutes, and that time was accepted. How many billable minutes did the firm record for the day?

A team earned 144 points initially. They multiplied by 7 through performance. They added 72 bonus points. Then 34 more points arrived. Finally, 65 additional points were added. A rival team scored 500 points but separate contest. How many total points earned?

On Saturday morning Kay's bakery baked 4 trays of rolls with 188 rolls on each tray, and then 10 more rolls in a small tin. In the afternoon, Lou's much larger bakery on the same street had 7 times as many rolls as Kay's had that morning, and Lou then baked 23 more, so Lou had far more rolls than Kay. In the evening Lou sold 2123 rolls to a hotel, which serves a dozen kinds of bread at breakfast. How many rolls does Lou have left?

A farmer started with 37 sheep in one pasture. He added 45 sheep to double the group. The flock grew by 6 times that new amount in the spring breeding season. Then it multiplied by 5 more due to additional births. Finally, it multiplied by 8 times again as he combined herds. He added 16 more sheep at the end of the week. A neighboring farm had 200 sheep but kept separate grazing areas. How many sheep are in the combined pasture now?

A student had 95 items. They added 37 items. They multiplied by 3 times. They added 35 items. They added 69 items. They removed 122 items. They added 4 items. Someone had a dozen items. There were 50 items elsewhere. How many items total?

Two collectors, Zainab and Theo, keep marble jars, but this story follows only Zainab's jar, which started at 130 marbles, more than Theo's jar held. A trade added 48 more marbles. She then lost 103 marbles in a big trade. A friend's request then cost her 56 more marbles. A tournament win added 75 more marbles, around the time a rival collector mentioned owning about a dozen rare marbles, unrelated to this count. Finally, she gave away 4 more marbles to a younger cousin. How many marbles were in Zainab's jar in the end?
A recipe needed 42 grams. Added 49 grams. Doubled mixture. Halved for portions. Multiplied by 9 for batch. Added 36 grams topping. Converting to ounces, how much final?

In the morning, Leah has 66 seashells in her collection from a previous trip to the coast. By midday, she finds 3 more shells during a beach walk. In the afternoon, her family stops at a second beach and she adds 18 more shells to her bag. By evening, a friend gives her a whole jar of shells, bringing her collection to 4 times what it had grown to. Right before bed, she sorts through a box from her grandmother's attic, bringing her total to 5 times what it had been. Her cousin Nora, who collects sea glass instead, has about 40 pieces for comparison. How many seashells does Leah have now?

A soup kitchen began the morning with 18 sacks of lentils and took delivery of 79 more. Every sack holds 9 kilograms. A grocer added 20 kilograms of loose lentils at midday, and a school harvest festival sent over 65 kilograms more. Through the afternoon the kitchen cooked with 664 kilograms of what it had. In the evening a wholesaler dropped off another 68 kilograms. The kitchen serves its meals at 12 long tables. How many kilograms of lentils does the kitchen hold now?

Early on Saturday morning Farmer Odile counted 179 eggs in her store room. Before breakfast her hens laid 13 more. At midday she sold 47 eggs to a village cafe. Her brother Pierre gathers eggs on his own farm, but he collected fewer that day than Odile did. In the afternoon a wholesaler swapped every egg still in Odile's store room for 6 quail eggs. That evening 531 of the quail eggs were packed and driven away. How many quail eggs were left in the store room?

A school library received 51 boxes of donated books, and every box held exactly 3 books. The librarian sent 137 of these donated books across town to a partner school that had lost its collection in a flood. She then found that 3 more of them had water damage on the spine and set those aside for recycling. A week later a parent walked in with 12 further books for the same donation shelf. The library's catalogue records the donation shelf as single volumes rather than as whole shelf-sets. How many donated books does the library have on that shelf now?

A budget projection started with 217 dollars. Unexpected costs removed 199 dollars (18 dollars). Strategic expansion multiplied by 9 (162 dollars). Market opportunity multiplied by 5 (810 dollars). Final allocation added 34 dollars. Converting to weekly budgets, this represented about 116 weekly spending. A contingency fund had 95 dollars but wasn't included. What was the final allocation?

Two shop owners, Isla and Ravi, tracked their coin drawer totals all day, and Ravi's drawer stayed noticeably lower than hers. Isla's drawer held 171 dollars at the start of the morning, and by midmorning, 11 more dollars came in from early customers. At midday, a bulk sale event made her total grow to 3 times its size. In the afternoon, 54 more dollars came in from a big order. Since her register logs everything in dollars and cents but the bank statement lists whole-dollar figures only, she always rounded carefully before her evening deposit, when the drawer's total was split evenly across 6 cash envelopes and only one envelope was tracked into the next day. Overnight, a matching bonus made that envelope grow to 6 times its size, and a final coupon reimbursement added 13 more dollars the next morning. How much money was in that envelope by the next morning?

A biology student counts 56 bacterial colonies on a dish and adds 27 more colonies from a second dish. The incubator is kept at 37 degrees. Overnight, each colony on the dish grows into 9 colonies. The next day 545 colonies die after a dose of antibiotic. Over the following night each surviving colony splits into 6 colonies. How many colonies are on the dish now?

Kofi counted 228 bricks in the yard, and Lena wheeled in 17 more, far fewer than Kofi had counted. A neighbour took 66 bricks away for a garden path, and 23 more were found to be cracked and were discarded. Each brick still in the yard weighs 8 kilograms. The yard always gives its loads in kilograms rather than in tonnes. What is the total weight, in kilograms, of the bricks left in the yard?

Ines began her collection with 54 postcards in a shoebox. Her friend Luca, who owns fewer than she does, gave her 22 from his own box. She then posted 54 of hers to family abroad. A market stall sold her 80 postcards in a single lot, and a cousin sent 15 more in an envelope. Her grandmother added 3 very old ones from the attic. Ines has been collecting for a dozen years. How many postcards does Ines have now?
A factory had 224 items. They multiplied by 3. They removed 501. They added 60 more. They multiplied by 7. They removed 569. His factory partner produced 100 items separately. How many items?

A concert hall starts ticket sales with 237 seats reserved. A group booking adds 7 more seats. A huge presale event brings the reserved count to 6 times what it was. A processing error releases 1,322 of those reservations back into general inventory. A second presale wave brings the remaining reservations to 7 times what they were. The hall's manager, Yusuf, mentions a smaller venue down the street only reserved 300 seats today, far fewer than this hall. A late cancellation wave removes 436 reservations. The remaining reservations are then split evenly across 6 ticket windows, and the story follows just one window's count from here. How many reservations does that one window have?

A dairy farm tracked the total liters of milk in its holding tank throughout the day, starting with 117 liters at dawn. During the morning milking, 34 liters were drawn off for the local creamery. By midmorning, a second herd's milking added 61 liters back into the tank. In the afternoon, the tank's contents were split evenly into 3 identical cooling vats, and only the first vat's amount was tracked from then on — the farmer noted this in her log as converting from tank liters to vat liters, a simple unit change. That afternoon, a delivery from a neighboring farm added 67 more liters to the tracked vat. By evening, a cheese-making batch used up 80 liters from the tracked vat. How many liters were in the tracked vat by the end of the evening?

A warehouse had 54 boxes. He multiplied by 6 for inventory. He removed 225 for shipment. He added 37 back from a return. He removed 52 for another order. The final was multiplied by 7 for a quarterly report. A competitor had 43 boxes. What was the final count?

Tara raised 136 tomato seedlings in her greenhouse, and she waters them twice a day. She sold 94 seedlings to a garden centre, and 5 more wilted. Her neighbour Raj kept fewer seedlings than Tara did. Each of Tara's remaining plants produced 8 tomatoes, and she sold every tomato for 5 cents. She then spent 1089 cents on new seed packets. How many cents did Tara have left?
A farm had 91 crops. They removed 88 crops. They added 44 crops. They removed 9 crops. They added 22 crops. They added 30 crops. Morning tending, afternoon watering, evening counting. How many crops?

A baker started with 202 loaves. She added 16 more from morning baking. She multiplied by 4 for packaging. She multiplied by 8 for distribution. She removed 4363 for a bulk sale. The bakery had 5 employees. How many loaves packaged?

At sunrise, a beekeeper's storage shed held 138 kilograms of honey, while a magazine article on the counter mentioned a record 900-kilogram harvest from a farm out of state. The morning crew split the honey evenly into six equal drums, and this story follows only the first drum. By midday, 21 kilograms were sold at the farm stand from that drum. In the afternoon, a matching donation from a co-op multiplied the drum's remaining honey fourfold. Later that afternoon, 2 kilograms spilled during transport. By evening, 57 more kilograms were added from a late extraction, but 14 kilograms were set aside for a wedding order. How many kilograms of honey were left in that drum by evening?
